rows.text: links qwords `[rcx]` and `+8` to `rcx` itself, stores 0 to qwords `+0x10`, `+0x38` and `+0x40`, dwords `+0x18` and `+0x2C`, word `+0x30` and byte `+0x32`, writes the dword bit patterns 0x3F800000 to `+0x1C` and 0x3BA3D70A to `+0x24` with 0 in dwords `+0x20` and `+0x28` (two qword stores), and returns `rcx`; passed in `r9` to the `00808FE4` call at `00792940` + 0x8D with `edx` = 0x48 and `r8d` = 4, and 1 other site forms it the same way
rows.why_here: the controller base constructor 00792940 this page names passes it to 00808FE4
